entities.name: Maria Rodziewiczówna
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Maria Rodziewiczówna was a Polish writer, among the most famous of the interwar years. Her works often addressed patriotism, rural life, and praised the countryside and peasantry. Rodziewiczówna is also noted for advocating for women's rights. Her writings include Wrzos (Heather), Dewajtis, Lato leśnych ludzi, Straszny dziadunio.
